cards.title: Binding Day Boardwalk Scene Chain Card
cards.chainSkill: link a made-up boardwalk binding scene to the next page with one returning detail
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only expanding file scene chain card for connecting a pretend Binding Day Boardwalk page to the next page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place this card, blank paper, a pencil, and one expanding file paper pocket on the table for a private made-up boardwalk chain: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: with the adult, write one start scene, one next scene, and a bridge detail that keeps the pretend boardwalk chain connected: ____________________.
cards.startScenePrompt: Start scene: write the binding cart, the loose page stack, and the boardwalk helper who notices one bright spine ribbon: ____________________.
cards.nextScenePrompt: Next scene: move to the paper-stall counter where the helper finds a second loose page with a matching ribbon mark: ____________________.
cards.bridgeDetailPrompt: Bridge detail: carry the bright spine ribbon from the first page into the next scene so the reader can follow the scene chain: ____________________.
cards.changeMarkerPrompt: Change marker: show one gentle change, such as the loose pages shifting into a new order beside the binding cart: ____________________.
cards.returnDetailPrompt: Return detail: bring back the first spine ribbon and explain how it helps the helper connect the two boardwalk pages: ____________________.
cards.filePocketPrompt: File pocket note: tuck the start scene, next scene, and ribbon bridge note into the expanding file paper pocket: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write only the spine ribbon, the next loose page, and one return detail for the scene chain: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: keep the Binding Day Boardwalk page in the paper pocket and add one made-up connected scene later: ____________________.

cards.title: Margin Note Market Scene Chain Card
cards.chainSkill: move one margin note through a pretend market scene chain without losing the paper clue
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only expanding file scene chain card for building a made-up Margin Note Market chain across two pages: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out this card, blank paper, pencil, and an expanding file paper pocket labeled for pretend margin notes: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: with the adult, start at one paper tag booth, move to the next page, and keep one margin note clue alive: ____________________.
cards.startScenePrompt: Start scene: write the paper tag booth, the tiny margin note on a folded page, and the keeper who spots it: ____________________.
cards.nextScenePrompt: Next scene: shift to the ribbon ledger table where another character reads the margin note in a new way: ____________________.
cards.bridgeDetailPrompt: Bridge detail: repeat the tiny margin note wording or shape so the second scene clearly belongs to the first: ____________________.
cards.changeMarkerPrompt: Change marker: add one paper-only change, such as the note moving from page edge to ledger corner: ____________________.
cards.returnDetailPrompt: Return detail: bring the original margin note back and write what the keeper understands after the ledger table scene: ____________________.
cards.filePocketPrompt: File pocket note: place the margin note clue and both scene pages in the expanding file paper pocket: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write the margin note, where it moves next, and what it means when it returns: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: save the Margin Note Market scene chain on paper and add one pretend booth detail later: ____________________.

cards.title: Almost Invention Workshop Scene Chain Card
cards.chainSkill: connect an almost-invention problem to a later paper repair scene
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only expanding file scene chain card for linking an Almost Invention Workshop problem page to a repair page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: keep the activity adult-led and paper-only, then set this card beside blank paper, pencil, and an expanding file paper pocket: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: with the adult, make a pretend invention almost work, then write the next scene where one clue helps it improve: ____________________.
cards.startScenePrompt: Start scene: write the cardboard gear, bent lever, and workshop helper who realizes the almost-invention needs one more paper clue: ____________________.
cards.nextScenePrompt: Next scene: move to the sketch table where the helper studies the gear note and tries a calmer pretend repair idea: ____________________.
cards.bridgeDetailPrompt: Bridge detail: carry the bent lever note from the first scene to the sketch table so the scene chain stays clear: ____________________.
cards.changeMarkerPrompt: Change marker: show one change, such as the gear sketch turning from a question mark into a labeled paper arrow: ____________________.
cards.returnDetailPrompt: Return detail: bring back the bent lever and write how the sketch table clue changes what the helper does next: ____________________.
cards.filePocketPrompt: File pocket note: file the start scene, sketch table scene, and lever bridge detail inside the expanding file paper pocket: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write the bent lever, the sketch table clue, and one return detail for the almost-invention: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: keep the Almost Invention Workshop scene chain in the paper pocket and add another pretend repair note later: ____________________.

cards.title: Appendix Archive Lab Scene Chain Card
cards.chainSkill: use an appendix slip to connect archive scenes across two paper pages
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only expanding file scene chain card for connecting an Appendix Archive Lab page with a later archive page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place this card, blank paper, pencil, and an expanding file paper pocket beside one made-up appendix slip: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: with the adult, build a pretend archive scene chain where one appendix slip changes meaning on the next page: ____________________.
cards.startScenePrompt: Start scene: write the appendix drawer, the numbered paper slip, and the archive helper who finds a missing label: ____________________.
cards.nextScenePrompt: Next scene: move to the sorting desk where the numbered slip points to a different made-up page clue: ____________________.
cards.bridgeDetailPrompt: Bridge detail: repeat the numbered appendix slip in both scenes so the archive chain feels connected: ____________________.
cards.changeMarkerPrompt: Change marker: show the slip changing from a loose clue into a sorted page marker with one added symbol: ____________________.
cards.returnDetailPrompt: Return detail: bring back the missing label and write how the sorted slip helps explain it: ____________________.
cards.filePocketPrompt: File pocket note: slide the appendix slip, start scene, next scene, and return label note into the expanding file paper pocket: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write the numbered slip, the sorting desk clue, and the returned missing label: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: keep the Appendix Archive Lab scene chain on paper and add one made-up appendix clue later: ____________________.

cards.title: Compass Craft Academy Scene Chain Card
cards.chainSkill: carry one compass craft direction through a two-page pretend scene chain
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only expanding file scene chain card for guiding a Compass Craft Academy scene chain across two pages: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out this card, blank paper, pencil, and an expanding file paper pocket for a made-up compass craft chain: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: with the adult, start with one pretend compass direction, change it on the next page, and return to the first clue: ____________________.
cards.startScenePrompt: Start scene: write the compass craft table, the north-point paper arrow, and the maker who needs a clearer direction clue: ____________________.
cards.nextScenePrompt: Next scene: move to the folded-map bench where the maker compares the arrow with a second paper compass mark: ____________________.
cards.bridgeDetailPrompt: Bridge detail: carry the north-point paper arrow into the folded-map bench scene so the scene chain has a clear link: ____________________.
cards.changeMarkerPrompt: Change marker: show one change, such as the arrow pointing toward a new craft symbol instead of the first mark: ____________________.
cards.returnDetailPrompt: Return detail: bring back the first north-point arrow and explain what it helps the maker understand now: ____________________.
cards.filePocketPrompt: File pocket note: put the compass arrow, folded-map clue, and return detail page into the expanding file paper pocket: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write the compass arrow, one changed mark, and one return sentence for the scene chain: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: save the Compass Craft Academy page in the paper pocket and add one pretend direction clue later: ____________________.
